name: browser-diagnostics
description: Local-only Chrome MV3 diagnostic extension for inspecting how web applications expose rendered data.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && vite build && vite build -c vite.agent.config.ts && node scripts/finalize-dist.mjs
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:e2e
scripts.build:test: rm -rf dist-test && vite build --mode test && vite build -c vite.agent.config.ts --mode test && node scripts/finalize-dist.mjs test
